reserved.name: cluster.x-k8s.io
reserved.reason: the core Cluster API types (Cluster, Machine, MachineSet, ...) are CRDs of kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api; providers define theirs in their own *.cluster.x-k8s.io groups

reserved.name: clusterctl.cluster.x-k8s.io
reserved.reason: the clusterctl Provider and Metadata types are CRDs of kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api (cmd/clusterctl) only

reserved.name: gateway.networking.k8s.io
reserved.reason: Gateway API is defined by the CRDs of kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api and is not served by kube-apiserver; implementations ship copies of those CRDs

reserved.name: kueue.x-k8s.io
reserved.reason: the Kueue types (ClusterQueue, LocalQueue, Workload, ...) are CRDs of kubernetes-sigs/kueue only

reserved.name: runtime.cluster.x-k8s.io
reserved.reason: the runtime extension type ExtensionConfig is a CRD of kubernetes-sigs/cluster-api only
